fields.value: Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other ceases conducting business in the normal course, becomes insolvent, makes a general assignment for creditors, has a receiver appointed, or becomes subject to bankruptcy/insolvency creditor-protection proceedings.

quotes.text:
W'estem Copper may, at its option, terminate this Agreement by written notice to
Glamis, effective immediately upon delivery of the notice, should Glamis cease conducting
business in the normal course, become insolvent, make a general assignment for the benefit of
creditors, suffer or permit the appointment of a receiver for its business or assets or avail itself
of, or become subject to, any proceedings under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act (Canada) or

Glamis may, at its option, terminate this Agreement by written notice to Western
Copper, effective immediately upon delivery of the notice, should Western Copper cease
conducting business in the normal course, become insolvent, make a general assignment for the
benefit of creditors, suffer or permit the appointment of a receiver for its business or assets or
avail itself of, or become subject to, any proceedings under the Bankruptcy and Insolvency Act
(Canada) or any other statute of any province or state relating to insolvency or the protection of
rights of creditors.

fields.value: Western Copper gives Glamis a 2-year non-competition covenant for Mining Activities in the Area of Non-Competition. Glamis gives Western Copper a right of first offer for intended cash dispositions or abandonments of Designated Mineral Properties.

quotes.text:
Western Copper covenants and agrees with Glamis that, for a period of 2 years
after the Effective Date, it will not, directly or indirectly, either individually or in partnership or
jointly or in conjunction with any Person, which will include being a principal, agent,
shareholder, or advisor of such Person or in any other manner whatsoever,
(a) carry on or be engaged in Mining Activities, or

(b) advise, lend money to, guarantee the debts or obligations of or permit its name to
be used by any Person who carries on or is engaged in Mining Activities,
in the Area of Non-Competition.

Glamis covenants and agrees with Western Copper that if at any time it intends to
dispose of a Designated Mineral Property for cash consideration or by abandonment, it will give
Western Copper notice (the ‘ Disposition Notice”) of the intended disposition. For a period of
30 days from the time of delivery of the Disposition Notice Glamis will, if requested by Western
Silver, entertain an offer from Western Copper to acquire the Designated Mineral Property.

ambiguities: Clause 2.2 says Glamis will entertain an offer “if requested by Western Silver,” although the covenant is stated to be with Western Copper and the offer is from Western Copper.
Clause 1.1(f) defines the Effective Date as “May 3, 200ri or such later date as determined under the Arrangement Agreement,” which affects the start and end of the 2-year non-compete period.

payments.description: Reasonable transfer costs incurred by Glamis for transferring an abandoned Designated Mineral Property to Western Copper, if Glamis intends to abandon it and Western Copper requests the transfer.
payments.conditionNote: Payable only if Glamis intends to abandon a Designated Mineral Property and Western Copper requests transfer; amount is the reasonable costs of transfer incurred by Glamis.

quotes.text:
In the case of a
Designated Mineral Property that Glamis intends to abandon, Glamis wall, if requested by
Western Copper, transfer such Designated Mineral Property to Western Copper at no cost save
and except for the reasonable costs of transfer incurred by Glamis.

ambiguities: Clause 2.2 does not fix the amount, currency, or due date for the reasonable transfer costs.

property owned or controlled by Western Silver or in which Western Silver holds any

ambiguities: The listed start and end dates assume the Effective Date corresponds to the Agreement date of 2006-05-03; clause 1.1(f) contains the OCR-corrupted date “May 3, 200ri” and allows a later date under the Arrangement Agreement.
Clause 1.3 extends covenants to subsidiaries and other Affiliates, but those entities are not individually named in the Agreement text.

ambiguities: Clause 2.2 creates a right of first offer rather than a true exclusive or sole acquisition right; it is classified as non-exclusive because Glamis may dispose of the property after the 30-day process if no acceptable agreement is reached.
Clause 2.2 says Glamis will entertain an offer “if requested by Western Silver,” although the covenant is stated to be with Western Copper and the offer is from Western Copper.
Clause 1.3 extends covenants to subsidiaries and other Affiliates, but those entities are not individually named in the Agreement text.
